caseNameFull: Dora E. Rooker and William V. Rooker v. Fidelity Trust Company and Fidelity Trust Company, as Trustee of the Estate of Dora E. Rooker
attorneys: Mr. Charles W. Cox for defendant in error, in support of the motion. Mr. William V. Rooker for plaintiff in error, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925, c. 229, § 1(a), 43 Stat. 937, Rooker v. Fidelity Trust Co., 261 U. S. 114; Rooker v. Fidelity Trust Co., 263 U. S. 413. Petition for certiorari denied.
